exposure: Surgical site infection status (cases vs. controls)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at a tertiary hospital in Nairobi, Kenya between November 1, 2021 and October 31, 2022 (n=1262), with 27 cases of surgical site infection and a 1:2 matched case-control design
finding: No significant association was found between exposure to surgical site infection risk factors and the development of surgical site infection, despite a positive trend.
gest_age: Measured, but specific values not provided
